summary: Full E2E frontend test of the reworked 5-stage CRO cycle at /cro as testpro@test.com (Enterprise owner). All 5 stages render, stepper + next/prev navigation work, and the full guided cycle (add friction -> add hypothesis -> create linked test -> enter results -> implement winner -> iterate) works. Live A/B stats and hypothesis status transitions verified.
verified_flows: Login via /auth (toggle to login, email button, submit) -> /dashboard OK
/cro loads: cro-page, cro-stepper with 5 steps (cro-step-1..5), cro-prev-btn/cro-next-btn navigation works

STAGE 1 (stage-analyze): metric-overall-conversion=31.8%, metric-opportunities=22, metric-won-deals=7, metric-worst-dropoff shown; NO fake month-over-month delta present; funnel-chart renders (Lead 100%/Qualified 81.8%/Proposal 63.6%/Negotiation 45.5%/Closed Won 31.8%); stage-conversions shows all 5 transitions; analyze-note (honest heatmap disclaimer) visible

STAGE 2 (stage-friction): manual add via friction-title-input + severity=high + add-friction-btn appended new item to friction-list (count went 6->7). Severity/category badges rendered. Seeded AI-tagged items present. auto-bottlenecks section NOT shown for this org's funnel because backend returned no bottlenecks (drop-off thresholds not met with current pipeline data) — expected behavior, not a bug.

STAGE 3 (stage-hypotheses): add via hypothesis-input + metric + lift + add-hypothesis-btn -> appears in hypotheses-list with Draft badge (count 6->7). start-test-<id> pre-fills newTest and jumps to Stage 4 with toast.

STAGE 4 (stage-tests): create with test-name-input + test-metric-input + add-test-btn -> appears in tests-list. Entering control 1000/80 and variant 1000/120 produced live test-stats-<id>: 'Lift: +50%, Confidence: 99.7%, Winner: Variant' matching backend. save-test-<id> persisted (toast Test saved). implement-test-<id> button appeared because winner was decisive.

STAGE 5 (stage-implement): metric-shipped, metric-validated, metric-tests-completed all render. Implementing added a new item to impls-list with impact badge. Linked hypothesis moved to 'Validated' status (verified by re-visiting Stage 3). iterate-btn (Start next cycle) jumps back to Stage 1.
notes: Console shows hydration warnings from visual-edits babel plugin (x-ve-dynamic <span> wrapping <option>/<select>). This is dev tooling instrumentation, not real app code, and matches the note in the review request. No functional impact.
One transient 'Failed to fetch' from a Dashboard fetchAllData call occurred during the initial /auth->/dashboard transition (likely aborted by navigation). Not reproducible on /cro. Not blocking.
Recharts 'width(-1) height(-1)' warning briefly from another page - not from ConversionOptimization (which uses custom bar divs, not Recharts).
critical_code_review_comments: ConversionOptimization.js delete handlers are optimistic (remove locally before API call). On failure they toast the error but do NOT roll back the UI state, so a failed delete would leave the frontend and DB out of sync until refresh. Low priority but worth noting.
seed_data_creation: Added TEST_UI friction, TEST_UI hypothesis, TEST_UI A/B test, and an implementation to org_15337f4cefc9 as part of the E2E flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: CRO 5-stage rewrite is fully working end-to-end. If retesting, note auto-bottlenecks may or may not render depending on current pipeline drop-off percentages returned by /api/analytics/cro; that section is conditional (funnel?.bottlenecks?.length > 0).
